subject: Certification phasing / CS & Ops interlock for ISO27001 + FedRAMP
messages:
From: Janelle Reyes <janelle.reyes@lighthammer.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-08-10 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: certification phasing + CS/ops interlock

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. Lighthammer is kicking off a vendor certification review across several suppliers and we'd like to align timelines and responsibilities early so the security and procurement teams can plan. High-level ask: can Redwood share your proposed phasing for ISO 27001 + FedRAMP readiness and clarify how your customer-facing CS / Ops teams will interlock during evidence windows and audits?

Specifics we care about:
- Planned region/scope for FedRAMP-readiness work (if you intend to pursue a FedRAMP authorization).
- Expected evidence windows (60/90/120-day samples) and how those map to CS/Support on-call for live reviewer requests.
- Control owners for encryption/KMS, logging/retention, and change management (names or role buckets are fine).
- Any blackout windows or planned maintenance during the proposed certification timeline.

We'd like a brief write-up we can show our InfoSec committee next week. If you can attach a scope matrix and suggested timeline that would be perfect.

Best,
Janelle
Janelle Reyes
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Lighthammer Health

[External attachment references: none in this message]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Janelle Reyes <janelle.reyes@lighthammer.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-11 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: certification phasing + CS/ops interlock

Janelle — thanks for the clear ask and the quick timeline. I'm looping in Kimberly (Security PM), Karthik (Head of Product), and Mina (Trust/Compliance) to keep owners visible. Attached: scope_matrix_v2.xlsx (draft) and cert_timeline_v1.pdf (high-level phases).

Proposal (short):
1) Phase 0 — Alignment & scoping (2 weeks): confirm service boundary, regional footprints (we expect US-first; EU optional depending on customer demand).
2) Phase 1 — Controls baseline & SIG/CAIQ intake (4–6 weeks): collect narratives and evidence owners. We'll field questionnaires and provide central artifacts (policies, diagrams, retained logs).
3) Phase 2 — Gap remediation & dry run (6–8 weeks): prioritized fixes and a SIG/CAIQ dry run with sample evidence.
4) Phase 3 — Auditor prep & intake (4 weeks): finalize control narratives, schedule auditor interviews, and freeze evidence windows for sampling.

How CS/Ops will interlock:
- We propose a rotating 2-week stand-by roster for CS (first-line) during Phase 3; security will commit a SME for escalation.
- Live evidence pull requests will be routed through Mina's team and triaged via the shared drive link (see Drive URL).

Control owners (role buckets):
- Encryption/KMS: Platform Security (owner: kimberly_park@redwood.ai)
- Logging & retention: Observability (owner: mina_haddad@redwood.ai)
- Change mgmt / deployment approvals: Release Eng (owner role: Release Manager, cc: karthik_iyer)

Blackout windows: tentative maintenance windows are Sunday 02:00–04:00 PT; we will avoid those for auditor sampling but will confirm once calendar is locked.

Next steps:
- Janelle: confirm this phasing suits Lighthammer's committee and whether you need EU scope added.
- Kimberley/Mina/Karthik: can you review the attached scope matrix and add named evidence owners in-column by EOD Friday?

Thanks — attaching docs now.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scope_matrix_v2.xlsx (application/service boundary draft), cert_timeline_v1.pdf (phased timeline)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Janelle Reyes <janelle.reyes@lighthammer.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-13 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: certification phasing + CS/ops interlock

Quick clarifications from security before we lock owners into the matrix:

1) KMS / key custody: We currently use a customer-segregated KMS in our private deployment offering and a managed KMS for hosted accounts. For Lighthammer's purposes, do you require customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) or is managed KMS acceptable during the baseline audit?

2) Evidence sampling windows: our suggested sample window is 90 days for log extracts and change records. For configuration snapshots (enclaves, images) we propose a 30-day snapshot retention for auditors. Is that compatible with your evidence policy?

3) Live reviewer access: we will provide scoped, time-limited observer accounts and an audit read-only bundle; can you confirm whether the auditors need console sessions or just artifact bundles?

I've added margin notes to the Drive folder (link above) with suggested named owners for encryption (Kimberly Park), logging (Mina Haddad), and change management (Karthik Iyer). I'll also call out any cross-region differences if you elect EU in scope.

If helpful I can run a 30-minute walkthrough for your InfoSec committee outlining the proposed evidence flows.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security PM, Redwood Inference
